title.value: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products
title.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products

status.provenance: A bill for an act relating to state government;

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

date.provenance: 2  Effective Date.  This act shall take effect July 1, 2025.

who.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

action.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

value: Aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments
products.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount. ... III.(a)  A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments for rugs or carpets to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

value: Sale or resale of used products
exceptions.provenance: (b)  This paragraph shall not apply to the sale or resale of used products.

intentionally_added.provenance: to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.
